description: Main module for Skills API operations, including create, list, get, and delete functions for skills, with both synchronous and asynchronous variants, integrating external provider configurations and internal handlers.

classes.name: LiteLLMLoggingObj
classes.description: Logging utility class for environment variable updates and request logging.

classes.name: BaseSkillsAPIConfig
classes.description: Base class for provider-specific skills API configuration, including request validation and URL transformation.

classes.name: BaseLLMHTTPHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler class for skills API operations, supporting create, list, get, and delete.

methods.name: _get_litellm_skills_handler
methods.description: Lazy initializer for the LiteLLM skills transformation handler.

methods.name: acreate_skill
methods.description: Asynchronous function to create a new skill, supporting both internal and external provider routes.

methods.name: create_skill
methods.description: Synchronous function to create a new skill, supporting provider-specific request transformation and HTTP handling.

methods.name: alist_skills
methods.description: Asynchronous function to list skills, supporting provider-specific request transformation.

methods.name: list_skills
methods.description: Synchronous function to list skills, supporting provider-specific request transformation.

methods.name: aget_skill
methods.description: Asynchronous function to retrieve a skill by ID.

methods.name: get_skill
methods.description: Synchronous function to retrieve a skill by ID.

methods.name: adelete_skill
methods.description: Asynchronous function to delete a skill by ID.

methods.name: delete_skill
methods.description: Synchronous function to delete a skill by ID.
